scope: UAE-MOE-MATH Grade 9 General production read-only inventory
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "CurriculumPedagogicalLessons" WHERE "Code" LIKE 'PED:UAE-MOE-MATH:L9:GENERAL:%') AS general_grade9_pedagogical_lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "CurriculumPackContentNodes" WHERE "FrameworkCode"='UAE-MOE-MATH' AND "LogicalLevelFrom"=9 AND "Pathway"='General') AS general_grade9_pack_nodes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "CurriculumPedagogicalLessons" WHERE "Code" LIKE 'PED:UAE-MOE-MATH:L8:GENERAL:%') AS grade8_general_lessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "CurriculumLessonContents" c JOIN "CurriculumPackContentNodes" n ON c."LessonNodeId"=n."Id" WHERE n."FrameworkCode"='UAE-MOE-MATH' AND n."LogicalLevelFrom"=9 AND n."Pathway"='General') AS grade9_contents
interpretation: Grade 9 General is not present in production DB in these checked tables; GitHub prepared content alone is not production publication. Grade 8 rows must be protected.
readOnlyNote: No student-level identifiers queried; only aggregate counts.
